Help centre

Orders

Track an order from the Orders page. Orders ship within two working days, and you will get a tracking number by SMS once your parcel leaves the warehouse. Delivery takes three to seven days depending on the pin code.

Returns

Most items can be returned within ten days of delivery. Start a return from the Orders page, pack the item in its original box, and our courier partner will pick it up. Refunds reach your original payment method within five working days of the pickup.

Payments

We accept UPI, cards, net banking and cash on delivery for orders under five thousand rupees. If a payment fails but money was debited, it is reversed automatically by your bank within a week.
